3) POSE: Standing, torso leaning slightly toward viewer; left hand pulling skirt waistband down/open at hip, right hand gripping fabric at opposite hip; legs not visible below frame.
4) CAMERA: Upper-body/cowboy-ish framing cut off at hips; low angle, slight upward tilt; no dutch tilt.
5) SCENE: Garage/workshop; motorcycle with rainbow prism reflection on headlight (left), hanging fluorescent tube light (top right), toolbox with wrenches (bottom right); moody dark-blue ambient lighting with warm key on character.
6) RATING VERDICT: R — covered chest but sensual emphasis (tight top, waistband-tugging pose, grin), no explicit or maximal tease elements.
